concepts.def: R-CH2OH; oxidises to aldehyde then acid.
Ag+ test: aldehyde gives silver mirror.
Blue Cu2+ -> brick-red Cu2O with aldehyde.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Acidified K2Cr2O7 distilled off immediately -> aldehyde. Reflux -> carboxylic acid.

Colour change: orange Cr2O7^2- -> green Cr^3+. Secondary -> ketone (no further oxidation). Tertiary -> no reaction.

Tollens' reagent: Ag(NH3)2+ reduced to Ag (silver mirror) by aldehyde only.

Fehling's solution: blue Cu^2+ reduced to brick-red Cu2O by aldehyde only. Ketones do not react with either.

Carboxylic acid + alcohol with conc H2SO4 catalyst <-> ester + water (reversible).

Example: ethanoic acid + ethanol -> ethyl ethanoate + H2O. Excess alcohol shifts equilibrium right.
